body: Lovely fine sand beach with no big waves due to the reef 100m offshore.Ideal for snorkelling as Sea Turtles are present most days as well as a selection of fish.
title: Calm seas and soft sand and not too busy

body: Polhena Beach is a tranquil, reef-sheltered beach located near the town of Matara on the southern coast of Sri Lanka. It is highly regarded as one of the safest beaches in the country due to its natural coral reef, which creates a calm, shallow lagoon with minimal waves, ideal for swimming for all ages, including children and non-swimmers.
title: Polhena beach

body: You get calm waves, clean sand, and easy access for swimming. Turtles stay close to the reef so you watch them from a few meters away. Local cafes serve fresh food at fair prices. The beach stays quiet in the morning, ideal for photos and a slow start. Good spot for a short break or a full day.
title: Clear water and a relaxed vibe

body: I was in search of a swimming beach and this was it! Reef break makes for calm water. I even swam with a sea turtle- thanks to the locals who found it.😊
title: Safe swimming beach

body: We snorkeled with Nirosh looking for turtles. Nirosh immediately identified the area where to find them and after a while we spotted them. It was great to have this experience led by Nirosh as it shone through his knowledge of the place and the turtles but above all the respect for them and the environment. If you want to make sure you see turtles in Polhena contact Nirosh! +94 775481252
title: Looking for turtles in Polhena

body: We did a guided tour with Nirosh +94 775481252, he knew exactly where to go to see the turtles. As it was off season we only spotted a few baby turtles however then went to another beach nearby where we encountered two big turtles who were super friendly. Whilst we were admiring the turtles, Nirosh swam further to gather the turtles favourite sea plants to feed them. We got super close with them and it was such a beautiful experience. Their calming nature is contagious. Nirosh was Respectful of the turtles and you can clearly see his love for them. He is literally an expert in spotting them. If you want to see turtles in anytime he is your guy!
title: Swam with turtles

body: Polhena Beach is great for snorkelling with turtles. Nirosh the turtle father will help you find them. Contact: +94 (77) 548 1252
title: Turtle beach

body: Beautiful beach, no waves all year round, clean water, gentle entrance, no rocks at the bottom and with pure sand. There is not much infrastructure nearby, except for one cafe that offered sunbeds - on the day of 1000 rupees, Sunbeds put palm trees in shade and you can order drinks there only. But there's not much shadow. Well, those who don't want to pay fold their towels in the sand and relax. It's all safe. The beach isn't very big, but there's plenty of room for everyone, especially liked to check out the locals, as they don't like the waves and just snort. There's also a spot on the beach where you can buy all sorts of inflatable things and snorkelling equipment, Lifeguards are also near their station.All in all, it's a pleasure to swim and sunbathe there.
title: Perfect Polhena

body: I have been here to snorkel with turtles. I have had the best guide. Nirosh +94775481252 is a turtle whisperer. I have met two turtles. One almost a 100 years old and one meter long. I was feeding them with sea grass so they really wanted to be with me, even hug me. Great experience. Amazing. Thank you Nirosh 🤩
title: Snorkeling with turtles

body: Located just to the west of Matara town it is not a long beach (120m) with calm waters conducive to safe swimming. Popular with local families especially on tge weekends. A few vendors and shops in the area.
title: Worth a visit especially for kids.

body: Wow, I am so glad I looked into best places to snorkel with turtles in the Mirissa area. In my opinion this should be the #1 thing to do on TripAdvisor for this coastline! We couldn't find anyone hiring out snorkels on the beach, so best to bring your own or borrow from your hotel if you can. Head there in the morning. There were very few people around. Spend 15 mins towards the back of the bay (you'll see the rocks coming out of the water) and you'll have an amazing time swimming with these beautiful creatures. Wet shoes advised (but not essential) as the sea floor is rocky. A calm, beautiful bay. Just bring essentials!
title: Snorkel with turtles! Don't miss this

body: Polhena Beach in Sri Lanka lacks the charm found in many other beaches with palm trees. It feels somewhat soulless – a visit with tuk-tuk or a short walk its ok, as there are more amazing beaches to spend your day.
title: Just walk and spend beach day somewhere else.

body: beautiful beach, not too many street shops etc... beautiful coral reef, no boats passing or damaging for the moment
title: Beautiful beach

body: In mid-December, the beach was very pleasant and uncrowded.Don't hesitate to go there in the morning before your breakfast :) transparent water without waves.Pay attention to the current. No problem settling down on your towel and enjoying the sun.
title: Excellent

body: Went in the morning around 10 am . Wasn't very crowded. There was one turtle but difficult to see as the water was muddy.Recommend wearing snorkelling shoes as there are a lot of rocks that may cut your feet
title: For snorkeling.

body: There is sea animal called ikiriya on rocks . It hurt 😞 my daughters leg yesterday and we went to hospital to removed it. But it is not dangerous. It is advisable not to keep the legs on rocks.
title: Ikiriya ( sea animal)

body: Nice low key beach when we visited. Very freindly snorkel hire people slr1000 for kit and helped us find turtles to swim with. A really good restaurant on eastern side called Fusion88 that served some of the best food we had had in the area
title: Great little beach if you want to see turtles

body: The water is a bit murky, It is not that easy to Spot turtles as advertised. Not my favourite Beach in Sri Lanka. Better go to neighbouring beaches.
title: Not that Great

body: We visited Polhena very early (before 8am) on a sunny morning in the monsoon season. We rented some snorkelling gear from the guys on the beach and within about 5 mins we saw a turtle! We saw 4-5 turtles in total plus some tropical fish and coral. We had the bay to ourselves which was very romantic. The water visibility was not the best due to it being the monsoon but we could still see lots of things. It would be incredible in the high season!! We suggest you agree the price of the equipment before you hire as we were charged 3000 LKR which is definitely too much.
title: Turtle snorkelling 🐢

body: Perfect season to visit Polhena beach is till end April every year, afterward the sea becomes bit rough, however thier are many people coming from all over the country to this beautiful place
title: Best season is till April every year

body: If you travel to Matara, Madiha, or even a little further away from Polhena Beach, it is well worth it to take a dip with these beautiful creatures. After trying twice and failing twice I decided to get a guide. The cost was virtually nothing, but as soon as I was in the water the guide zoned in on a Olives Ridley turtle and there he was, plucking grass from the seabed and passing the food t me, to pass to the turtles.I don't necessarily agree with this hand feeding by tourists but I think this little act could be helping the turtles to stay popular, which in turn encourages locals to protect their investment and keep the beaches clean. I was called to the beach one particular evening by a Tuk-Tuk driver and I actually saw a turtle laying her eggs. Truly spectacular. The turtle had a big scar on its back due to, I was told, a shark attack.I sat in a small restaurant one day for several hours and watched the feeding turtles' heads popping up and down in the surf, without any interruption or intervention from humans. There is very little input from humans here and I think it is one of the best places in the whole of Sri Lanka to view these several different species of beautifully wild sea creatures.
title: Unforgettable

body: This beach used to have many locals. Now it is quiet for the moment, because local tourist unfortunately dont have the gasoline to visit at the moment. But the queiet times of covid surely did the nature some good. I had a very very good guided snorkling tour. With Dilib, you can ask about him at Sunil Rest guesthouse. I was just 3 steps into the sea and all around me where turtles swimming. you could really swim and play with the turtles, feed them. It was amazing to swim with the turtles. They really seemed to enjoy it. They did not swim away. Also we swam to the coral reef and saw many colorfull fish and living coral reef. It was amazing. a guided snorkling tour is not expensive at all. You just need a day of clear water. You can also take your own snorkling gear or rent snorkling gear. We are no great swimmers, but my child and me already with our own snorkling gear not far in the sea could see many coloured fish. So highly recommended. also many beaches in Sri Lanka are not safe for swimming for small children. But here there is little current en no waves because the beach is protected by the 4 km long coral reef. Good place for families and children.
title: beautiful snorkling

body: We went to the Polhena beach yesterday. Not much crowded and it so beautiful. Shallow beach and it is one of the safest beaches in Sri Lanka.
title: Beautiful and safe beach

body: It is very beautiful safest beach and it is very good beach to swim and enjoy. You can spend whole day in this beach without any doubt
title: Good and unforgettable experience

body: This is a great place to see turtles. The water is really shallow and the visibility is poor close to the shore but once you get out further it improves. We went mid morning on a Thursday and it wasn’t busy but it was windy. I think an early start would have been better. We were out for about an hour and saw 4 large turtles who all seemed used to being watched and weren’t startled by us. The beach itself is nothing special and we didn’t hang around after snorkelling.
title: Good for turtle spotting, not the best beach.

body: A small beach which is a favourite place of the locals. You will also find many offers for snorkeling and turtle watching. It blows sometimes, so don't be surprised when you have sand between your teeth.
title: Swimming with many locals.

body: This place gets very crowded with public during holidays and weekends. Therefore you will not be able to enjoy if you go on those days. Go on a weekday. This is a small strip of very calm beach and you can snorkel nearby. The water is very clean.
title: Never go on a weekend or holiday

body: Beautiful beach and great for a morning bath. Note that this is a sea frequented by many locals. If youre looking for a secluded sea swim try and go on a weekday or early morning.
title: Stunning beach but not always secluded

body: Clean and spacious beach. Not overcrowded with hawkers and other nuisance peddlers. Could see the occasional turtle if you keep a sharp lookout. the best time to wade in would be morning before 10 AM as the peace and tranquility is much more enjoyable than during peak hours...only thing is the water may be too cold -relatively speaking from a tropical perspective - snorkeling is recommended and the beach offers shallow swim areas specially fit for kids - take care of the drift as there is a bit of a drift towards the left as you observe facing the Indian ocean which may be more pronounced due to the natural and artificial curvature made by the granite protection that has been laid to prevent erosion either side of the Polhena beach. Altogether a wonderful enjoyable experience - much recommended for Matara visitors.
title: Fun beach great for snorkeling...

body: Fabulous beach, quieter than Mirissa beach. More local people. For two days running we had the most wonderful experience swimming with green turtles. Most people very respectful of these amazing creatures. You do not have to pay for a tour, just go swimming.
title: Swimming with green turtles

body: Twice been to the beach. This very beach is very popular among local people and a small piece of beach for tourists, that look very uncomfortable to wear bikini next to local guys in sarong and full body swimsuits
title: Too crowdy

body: Polhena beach is a large sea pool which has a uniform height up to a large distance from the coast. And due to the coral reef, the tides are blocked. Therefore the water is very calm and relaxing. This is done to protect and secure the tourists who are especially enjoying quality time with their families and friends in Matara. These characteristics make it a perfect place to have a sea bath in Polhena Beach It is relatively more famous among Sri Lankans than the tourists
title: Polhena Matara Beach

body: Yes they have turtles just off the beach but it’s a very busy beach with the localsZ there isn’t many shops or shade either

body: It's beautiful beach I ever see on my life kind people nice location attractive place I dance I love it I hope to visit again relax with your self huge area can see turtles have googles for sale near by restaurant and pub hotels are around every time peoples around
title: Marvelous

body: This is really beautiful beach in down south but gave many local people there have turtles you can snorkeling with turtle
title: Great but little dirty

body: Had a wonderful relaxing during our vacation in srilanka. But rain. I really like the snorkeling. Missed my hopes. but about have to say one wonderful day with very tasty sea foods.
title: Superb place to relax

body: A safe place for kids to swim. The water is shallow and has a few deeper Zones where you can swim and Dive.IF you are Lucky you can meet a Turtle, when you are snokelling. There are lots of locals
title: Good for kids to swim.

body: I went on September which is their low season. Once you got there, the locals gonna offer you the snorkeling gears to see the turtles ...etc. Not many tourists in the morning when I was there and it was pretty empty as if the beach belongs to me. You don’t need any “tour package” to see the turtles. Get there and jump into the sea and you will see plenty of them. All you need to do is bargain a little with the locals for the gear renting and guide you to see the turtles (if you are not confident to look for it on your own) I strongly suggest you wear the snorkeling shoe / take the fins as the sea bed is very rough and I saw some sea urchins hiding around the corals and thank God I didn’t hit one when I was bare foot in the sea. Well I only saw turtles around and no fishes, so I am not sure this kind of snorkeling will meet your expectation. The corals are craps, are those even corals, I wasn’t sure. However, I enjoyed the snorkeling as you are literally swimming with them. Another side note: the current was strong though it is shallow, maybe I went there after the heavy rain. I wasn’t sure about it. Anyway Swimming harder if you feel that you are drifted.
title: This is where you snorkeling with the turtles

body: Polhena beach is tiny, not even particularly clean and can be rammed with buses and locals at weekends or festivals. BUT if you like swimming with turtles, this is an incredible place to do just that. For best results, a lovely local called Taminder (see picture) helped us spot them and stay with them.You can see them by yourself if you look out for their heads coming up for air but he definitely has a knack for finding and keeping them.We were here off season so the visibility was terrible due to monsoon winds, and the current pretty tricky too. We found going in on the right-hand side was most sheltered from the current.
title: Swim with dozens of turtles

body: This is a very good beach around here. The beach is good to have a sea bath close to the beach. The view very good.
title: Sea Bath

body: My son and my husband had a grate time having a bath in this beach. The water was not very deep and much clenner they had showers with tap water to take a bath after .Parking is very convinent . I would recommend anybody who have an interest in having a beach bath in Sri Lanka.
title: good spot to have a nice sea bath

body: Very quiet beach with a lovely area to swim in. Few restaurants around and saw some turtles swimming around. No real shade to speak of so can get very hot in the middle of the day.
title: Quiet location

body: We came here by tuk tuk from our hotel and loved this beach, the part where we went, there were not any sun loungers so it was lying on the beach which was ok.Snorkeled and were shocked by how many turtles there were, I looked to my left at my 13 year old son and next to him was a turtle swimming along as well, was just amazing. Lots of different fish too, nice clean beach and water was on the whole pretty clean. Nice and shallow for quite a way too. My son and husband literally spend hours snorkeling it was go good.Our second week was a holiday week for Sri Lankan's (children's holiday I believe) and it was massively busy compared to the previous week (literally coach loads being dropped off), we did see some pick up a turtle out of the water which we weren't overly impressed with so some of the Sri Lankan's need to be educated.Anyway fabulous beach and well worth a visit, especially if you want to swim with the turtles.
title: So many turtles

body: Polhena is a special place. A hidden secret. But probably not for long. Enjoy it now, peaceful and beautiful. We enjoyed a wonderful snorkel outing with the expert Nirosh (0775481252 + 0769013261). The beach and reef is his backyard and he knows where the big morays live, large porcupine fish, interesting kinds of sea cucumbers, rays, etc.... plus of course all the turtles!!! You will see so much with his guidance.... definitely worth it!!
title: Best beach, best snorkeling, best guide!

body: We used to visit this place very often. Very beautiful beach and always crowded with both locals and foreigners. However, the facilities available is not enough, such as changing rooms, Wash rooms etc.,
title: Beautiful Beach near Matara

body: This is one of the beaches in Sri Lanka where u can enjoy clear, blue waters, swim with fishes, eat an ice cream or two and relax. Not very crowded and there are a lot of places to stay near by and also a few good restaurant.
title: Beautiful, clear beach

body: Very nice beach for snorkeling. Some pretty nice restaurants with amazing view.Take advantage of the sun beds for a small nap.
title: Amazing beach

body: This beach is more of a local hangout spot. It’s small and perfect for the traveller who likes to see the local life. The waves break far out so the water is pretty calm, warm, and clear. By far this has been my favourite beach in Sri Lanka so far... minus the stray dogs that just break my heart.
title: Beautiful

body: This is a very popular beach both for tourists and the local people. Fairly safe to enjoy the warm water and take in the sun on the sandy beach
title: Beach relaxation

body: Wonderful breach with white sand and blue water. It’s ideal for good swim and snorkeling however tide hight is very minimal and not good for surfing. Beach is super clean but it’s a famous place among local and it’s get real busy in weekend so it’s best to avoid weekends
title: Wonderful breach with white sand and blue water.

body: This is a lovely beach with loads of space to sunbathe, it is popular with the locals at weekends. The sea is shallow so it is good for children and you can snorkel easily to see the turtles! There are loads of restaurants and guest houses nearby. I wish I could have stayed longer.
title: A welcome relief from the more touristy beaches

body: ....but if there is one turtle spotted, the snorklers and swimmers from a 100m radius will all converge on the poor animal with cameras and snorkel and fins and what not, and the visibility will decrease to zero in a few seconds as the ground is stirred up.If you happy to snorkel and swim in some murky waters (there is a river coming in nearby) and dont mind doing so amongst many people then enjoy. Its a friendly place and relaxed, just not that enjoyable to me. The sea has a reef here, so there is a shallow area between the sandy beach and the reef, ideal for kids probably.
title: yes, they have turtles there... but

body: snorkeling tour with Nirosh was incredible - we saw a plenty of turtles, a lot of different types of tropical fishes and had an amazing time together with my boyfriend. Nirosh a real expert and a man who can be fully trusted - even though I was a bit nervous at the very beginning, Nirosh was really patient and helped me a lot to enjoy the private snorkeling tour. wide variety and good quality pf snorkeling equipment.absolutely worth it and highly recommended !!please find Nirosh contacts below:name, surname: Nirosh Hewaphone number: 0775481252e-mail: nirosh.hewa@gmail.comFB: Hewa Nirosh
title: amazing snorkeling with turtles experience

body: I have read a number of reviews about this place. I'm quite surprised by some of the comments. There are lots of locals here, which we haven't seen at Mirissa or Weligama, but that's a positive thing. They're really friendly and we got no sense that they didn't like Bikinis! There's shade at the top of the beach for those that want it and there's shops and restaurants close by. When we visited, the beach was clean. There's plenty of cheap accommodation nearby too but best of all, THERE'S TURTLES! Every time we went in the sea, we saw them. We brought our own gear but there's plenty of places that hire it out. The current is sometimes strong but it runs along the shore and it's shallow so there's little danger. Here's a place where you and your children can swim up close with huge Green Turtles for free. If you're looking for a holiday beach full of sunbeds, tourists and parasols, this is not the beach for you. Maybe the locals have got it right?
title: Free snorkeling with Turtles!

body: We wanted to see turtles and based on the reviews we chose to do a snorkel tour with Nirosh at Polhena Bay. Within minutes we were swimming with turtles - it was amazing! We spent over an hour snorkelling around the bay and saw and interacted with many turtles plus countless tropical fish, eels, stingray and plants. Nirosh was an enthusiastic and informative guide and ensured we had the best time possible. All the equipment is provided making it great value for money. Would definitely recommend. Contact him on 077 548 1252.
title: Fantastic snorkel tour with Nirosh

body: This is a small, congested, polluted beach in Matara city. Not worth having a bath. Mirissa is a close by , better beach .
title: Small, congested beach

body: The beach is very pretty, quite small and crowded but so worth the travel. We saw many sea turtles, sting rays, eels, plenty of fishes.. the sea was calm and the current not so strong in here. Of course it is not the best snorkling in Asia but compared to that we didn't see over a meter in any other beaches due to the sand and current this was excellent.Also one of the fews where also kids can swim quite safely. Theres maaaany locals on the weekends and afternoons but I like to see how they enjoy their free time and didn't see this as a negative at all.
title: Best snorkling in Lanka (from the beach)

body: Polhena is a nice quiet area frequented by mainly backpackers! At the end of the beach you can do some really good safe free snorkelling! There are some nice deep pools in the reef but don’t swim near the red flag at high tide! It’s there for a reason!!
title: Great free snorkelling

body: We went snorkling in Polhena Bay this morning with Nirosh. He was a fantastic guide and within 10 minutes we were floating with large turtles and watching them graze and the coral bed. The bay is not deep, for the not experienced swimmers, and the sea is far more gentle than in Mirissa. Truly a bucket list experience. Thank you so much Nirosh.His contact details are 077 5481252 and his email is nirosh.hewa@gmail.com.You can meet him at the Polhena Bay Resort.Enjoy
title: Snorkling with turtles with Nirosh

body: Nice and clean beach in near marissa. There are soo many places to rent snorkeling items. Recommend beach in polhena
title: Nice Snorkeling

body: Best place in the Mirissa area to snorkel with turtles. Don't take a tour, there is no need - take a tuk tuk to polhena beach, just before you arrive you will see hut where a very friendly guy is renting out excellent snorkeling equipment for 1000 rupees for as long as you need. He is located right at the best bay to see them and it took me about 5 minutes to find one. Saw 3 in total. Perfect for solo travellers like me, who don't want a guide but need somewhere to leave your stuff
title: Sea Turtles!

body: Polhena beach is our favorite beach in Sri Lanka. It is a calm town, with a village feel, and very beautiful beaches full of turtles! Polhena Bay Resort even has its own little beach! Nirosh is a master snorkeler and friend of the turtles. He even managed to take our 6 year old daughter out for her first snorkel. Thanks to his calmness and friendliness, she wasn't scared at all, and she was even able to touch and feed turtles. We highly recommend Nirosh for a wonderful snorkel experience! His contact # 0775481252, 0769013261
title: Master snorkel guide at Polhena Beach

body: We were to Polhena beach because we heard that there the sea is calm and the water is not deep so it's good for snorkeling. And that proved to be true. However the beach is small and you don't find many facilities like in bigger nearby beaches. So if you want a quiet beach where you can do some snorkeling, Polhena is good for that. Ciprian, România
title: A quiet and small beach good for chilling out and snorkeling

body: I and my son had a rewarding kayaking experience to an island in the Indian ocean. The uninhabited island was rich with exotic fish and crustacians. Also ruins of an ancient Pagoda was seen.
title: experience based stay

body: we went to polhena beach matara with my family, nice beach nice location, very sunny beach, mostly this is crowded and very famous among the local people, also diving and watch sea turtles also available, can drive to the beach directly and vey near to matara town,
title: went to polhena beach with the family

body: Polhena beach was in uncleanest place in Sri Lanka we have seen. There was enomous amount of litter everywhere. Also far too much people and cars in the beach. Locals have parked their cars ca 2 meters from water. We did not see any other tourists in the beach, except us. Do not recommend at all, also do not recommend taking hotels in that area.
title: Not nice

body: Lovely beach which seems to be really popular with locals. The water is calm so it was great for younger kids and it's really pretty. There is a small shop to get some cool drinks from. The only downside is that there is not much shade.
title: Nice and calm for young kids

body: The main Polhena beach is really crowded. But the Polhena Bay Resort offers a very small but a much calmer beach. You must definitely take the snorkelling tour with Nirosh (0775481252). He has 29 years experience and very sharp eyes. Although the corals are unfortunately all dead he was able to show us many different animals and provided useful information. It was not one of the typical touristy boat snorkelling tours. We basically started to swim along the corals and saw so many happy turtles. Please respect wild life and don’t touch them!!! After having a lovely snorkelling tour we highly recommend Matara-Polhena since it is much less touristy than Mirissa and very peaceful small village full of friendly people. Definitely worth to stay for a day or two.
title: Snorkelling with Nirosh at nice calm safe beach

body: use to go to this beach every time we visit Matara. The beach is full of crowd in the week ends. Free access to the lovely beach. not deep at all.
title: Nice place to Swim

body: This is quite a crowded beach for the locals, and I was not very comfortable in my swimsuit there. Don't go too far into the sea because the currents can take you away!
title: For the locals

body: I saw turtles from the shore and up close when I was snorkelling! I stayed at Polhena Bay Resort which was right on the beach and they have the equipment available for customers.
title: Turtles

body: I had such a great time snorkeling, I saw three turtles, a couple Mantra (tiny sting ray looking fish and many tropical fish). i went in October 2018, and the sea was pretty clear. i rented my snorkeling gear from Aja Snorkeling center. (green turtle snorkeling center). he is about a three minute walk from the beach. he has a full line of gear in all sizes from children to adult size fins, mask and life vests. he also provide snorkel guides for those that would like a guide. after an enjoyable morning snorkeling in the warm sea, Aja provided hot Tea and snacks. inclosed is a few photos of Aja Snorkeling Center.For a small beach area, its pretty nice. what i like about it, it wasn't very busy. I started out snorkelling in a small cove and then doggy paddle (as i'm not that great of a swimmer) to some of the other reefs. the snorkeling area of the sea isn't very deep.for the beach side for those that just wants to sun bathe. its pretty nice. the local children enjoy tossing the ball in the sea so i found myself playing catch :-). Sri Lanka is one country, that i really enjoy visiting, do to the friendliness of the people.
title: another return visit to Polhena beach and snorkeling.

body: A Natural pool created by the corals its beautiful & safe if we don't venture out to the danger areas. Though it is not what it used to be, like in every where else, snorkeling will be interesting with corals & colorful fish.
title: Natural Pool

body: I visited this at the of last month. it was very relaxing and i was there for like 4 hours. it is a good please to visit, there are many shops that you can buy many things related to beach activities. you can rent diving equipment as well for very reasonable price. all in all it is very good place that you must visit and I'm hoping to go back as well

title: Not much beach here

body: Grate place to visit near Matara Town. Lots of nice restaurants with privet beaches mostly crowded in public beach
title: Grate place

body: Visited the beach July 2018.We were hoping to go snorkelling and hopefully spot a turtle but the water was not clear at all, most probably due to strong winds at the time. We did not come across any turtles either.Still great for a swim as no big waves like many other beaches in the south.
title: Beautiful beach not too busy

body: Polhena beach is nice sandy beach in Matara coastal town of Sri Lanka. Safest place for sea bathe. Clean water and less rocks which will give more comfort to swim. After sea bath there is facility for shower.
title: Nice beach

body: This is a unique beach in tje southern coast of Srilanka.Weekends maybe a little bit more crowded. Recommend to visit this beach on weekdays .
title: Excellent beach in the southern coast

body: We did like the beach but really want to warn you about the stream. Even though it looks calm, it was scary how fast the water takes you away. It's a beach where lots of locals come, they are very friendly but are not used to see a lot of bikini's being worn in public :)
title: Nice beach but be careful of the jetstream

body: The best beach in the area is a small sandy cove that's sheltered by a reef offshore. There's good snorkelling in the bay, and though visibility is not that great, turtles are very regularly spotted here. It's popular with locals at weekends who rent goofy inflatable toys and frolic in the surf, but it's usually quiet on weekdays.
title: polhena beach is small sandy beach

body: Polhena beach does not have all that much to recommend it when compared to other Sri Lankan beaches apart from the fact that you are able to swim with the turtles when you snorkel which was an incredible experience.
title: Swimming with turtles

body: Polhena is a quiet beach with not so many tourists. Local people are nice and friendly, some nice hotels are also here. It is a very clean beach. Alcohol not allowed anywhere in the open public in Sri Lanka and you will not get trouble here. Generally it is an awesome Polhena beach. It is a wonderful place to have a safe, natural sea bath. Coral seemed mostly dead, and water was very shallow. It is a very small beach, not ideal for whole day to hang on. There are lots of local people mostly doing swimming and bathing in the sea. The surrounding places and accommodations are nice. Select a great place and get into the water but do not go no further beyond your chest height level of water, if you are looking for a safe swimming beach. You can see corals, turtles and more of the marine creatures if you are lucky. There was some small colorful fishes, it is more a local beach than a touristic one as the locals are many in numbers. We had a nice overall experience. The beach becomes noisy due to overcrowding with local people who play around and sing and enjoy. The crowds of people plus the pollution from the Matara Nilwala River have all but spoiled the sights of marine life above and below the water. Avoid weekends as the place is heavily crowded. If you want to have a calm sea bath go early in the morning. The beach is very scenic too. Now you have to pay for parking and there are lot of shops. Why don’t you enjoy a swim at Polhena Beach.
title: Awesome Polhena Beach is Clean, Crowdwd, Noisy, Shallow, Colourful Fishes, Turles Etc Can be Seen.

body: Go early if you want to get a spot in the shadow. There are no currents due to the reef ahead, so it's very safe for the kids to snorkle also on their own. We actually saw some turtles swimming in peace just next to us, but there are not very many fishes to be seen and the coral reef is dead. There is a small place offering delicious fruit juices next to the beach. Otherwise, there are no public toilets. We got the with a TukTuk and arranged for pick-up later on, as it's quite far from the main beach road.
title: Snorkling with turtles, safe for kids

body: Polhena Beach is one of the safest beach to swim because the waves do not come in as it is sheltered by a reef ofshore. it will be like swimming in a swimming pool.it is located about 5 kms from Matara town. Matara is connected to Colombo via a Southern expressway so your travel time is just 2 hours. You do not have to enter Matara town. You will exit the southern expressway and head towards Matara town. In the second signal (T-junction) turn right into the Galle road and you will have to drive for about 3 kms. it is also connected by train. Train journey will take about 3 1/2 hours. Most part of train journey is close to the sea coast and there are many a time during the journey you can see beaches from the train. From Matara town or train station you can take a tuk tuk for less than 500 LKR. You can also take a local bus that goes to Weligama or Galle and take a tuk tuk from the main road.To reach the beach you will have to drive less than a km from the main road ( Matara - Galle road). the road close to the beach will be narrow so you will have to give way for the on coming traffic by pulling aside. Parking should not be a problem. You also have a bathing place where you can shower and change after you swim in the beach. There are hotels available if you want to stay overnight or spend a couple of days there. For us it was a day trip so we did not explore this. Neither did we explore the restaurants since we packed our lunch and snakcs. There are also shops selling you beach wears so you do not have to worry if you are not carrying one.The water will be only about waist high till the reef formation. You can swim safely . Even a person who did not know swimming was able to enjoy myself in the water for more than 2 hours with no fear of drowning. if you are looking for surfing this may not be the place for you. There are also no shades where you can camp on the shore. So you need to carry a beach umbrella to set up camp.
title: For a safe swimming

Also roads are very narrow and having big local tourist busses on these roads doesn't help the traffic. We did a second visit the next morning (early). Very pleasant with less crowd and calm seas( normally calm in the morning).There is no proper restaurants in close proximity. Culture resort has a nice little restaurant but a little slow in service. body: We stopped here from Tangaller Weligama - it was one of my highlights. We hired snorkels and went out for a swim to see turtles. In the space of an hour or so we saw about 8 turtles. Big ones too and in their natural habitat. We initially had out bags on the beach but noticed a couple of people hanging around our bags so we moved them back to the car and they moved on. Be careful of your belongings here. The beach was not busy and felt quite empty. Beautiful spot and the sea was calm. We didn't bother with the tour but the guy came out anyway and signalled when he spotted turtles. We ended up giving him a tip as he was helpful and friendly. Couldn't believe how close the turtle would come they were within touching distance. Very cool experience! Well worth the stop. The facilities are not great tho so be prepared.

body: We snorkel frequently back in Australia / Indonesia. Went to check out Polhena as has been advised that it was the best snorkelling spot close to Mirissa. So disappointing. The visibility is almost zero, the coral is mostly dead, the whole sea floor was covered in dirty-looking silt plus the odd plastic bag. We spent 20 mins in the water before being so grossed out that we left. Also the "beach" (dirty rubbish strewn strip of sand) had a very weird menacing kind of vibe - lots of local guys many of whom were drunk at 10.30am, no women at all. We were advised of frequent daily thefts of bags from the beach by several other travellers. Definitely would not recommend Polhena to anyone.
title: Don't bother!!!

body: So many beaches in Sri Lanka are beautiful but are difficult or even dangerous to swim in the sea. Polhena has a shallow lagoon protected by a coral reef so is perfect, especially around low tide.Myriad of coral fish and regenerating coral...stunning.Stay at SUNHIL'S rest guesthouse for the perfect visit.
title: Great beach to snorkel and swim with turtles.

body: We stayed at a guest house right on the beach so had a lovely view all day long. We arrived on a Sunday and were told that bus loads of local people come for a day out, so the small beach did get quite busy, but even so we spent a very happy Sunday relaxing there. Unfortunately some of the day tripper men had been drinking alcohol all day and by home time were rather worse for ware, it was amusing at first seeing them fall about but after an hour it got rather irritating, especially as young children were around. For the rest of our stay the beach was very quiet, we could watch turtles very close to the shore and the water is quite shallow so you can snorkel --- though my husband did it and he didn't see very much. There are a few places to get food on the road that runs at the back of the beach, also a few people sell clothing and toys from an area at the back of the beach.my advice would be visit the beach but avoid visiting on a Sunday .
title: Avoid Sunday's

body: Nirosh Hewa, a charming man born in Polhena, knows all about TURTLES - and he is eager to take you to a snorkeling trip. Every morning he enters the nice garden of Polhena Village Beach Resort, posting himself on the balustrade overlooking the ocean. Whenever he takes his fins and snorkeling mask, he is ready to know the direction. If you want to meet the turtles under water - follow him! Everybody, honestly everybody who came back from a snorkeling tour with Nirosh was very happy, and so was I, when I met a huge (1-2 meters) friendly looking, smoothly floating turtle, touching her shield and following her for some minutes from here to there. Synchronously swimming with such a impressing animal is an amazing feeling. (No need to bring your own snorkeling equipment, you can rent it here.) If you rather go on a river safari watching crocodiles, birds and monkeys Nirosh's eyes swap from turtle eye (his own nick name) to crocodile eyes. Last but not least Nirosh is a very pleasurable person, I'm guaranteeing you are having a very pleasant time with him.
title: Mister Turtle Eye @ Polhena Village Beach Resort

body: Polhena beach is a very small beach, famous among the tourists because of its calm waters. Protected by a reef, the waters form a shallow natural pool, perfect for children and families. Although the water is clear, the beach itself is not so clean (I even found two pieces of broken glass on the sand). At the beach, there are vendors offering buoys and goggles for snorkeling, a lifeguard booth and a police station. In the surroundings, there is a small temple and a few hotels and restaurants. On weekends, cars and buses arrive here and the place gets crowded.
title: A natural swimming pool

body: Polhena Beach is a couple of kilometres outside the main town of Matara, in the Dondra Bay at the southern tip of Sri Lanka. It is generally quieter than the main town beach, though gets very busy in the tourist season. The golden sand is very inviting though it can be littered. Be cautious of the waves which can be rough at certain times of the year (I was just there in July and they were really strong). It is a good beach to stop at for a while to 'chill out' and enjoy the sea views.
title: Beautiful sand and quieter than the town centre

If bins and signs were provided this would help. Thumbs up for the eco-friendly inflatables that were for rent, as buying would only mean more plastic ending up being thrown away.
title: Nice little place for a swim, quite a lot of rubbish

body: Really disappointed how polluted this place has been..This was once happen to be the number one attraction place in Matara but now due to heavy environment pollution its not recommended to have a bath here.. If you badly want to have a bath in Sea please walk to Madiha side, Nobody from matara baths brom here.. no more..The hotels around here is overpriced and not clean.. not recommended..
title: DONT BATH from here

body: We walked here from our hotel and spent a pleasant hour watching the locals at play and had a brief look at the market at the top of the beach. The swimming here appears to be very safe but the beach does get very crowded.
title: Sunday stroll .

body: Nothing much to attract you except for the sunbathing lovers. Relax and chill out with friends appreciating the great beauty of sunny beach is the way to enjoy it here.
title: The place for sea lover

body: As others have stated, the beach is small, although you can find other patches if you keep walking up the Beach Road, taking the paths to the water when you can see them. Mostly, I found the narrow road, the mostly deserted guest houses and restaurants, the oversized cars speeding inches away from me with their stereo blasting depressing after a while. I'd suggest going to the main beach at Matara, which allows for more breathing room.
title: The scene got tiresome after a while

body: Beach is rather dirty, full of people and actually nothing new to see comparing to other beaches. Also beware of locals who will invoice you for parking when you will decide to run away from that place.
title: nothing special

body: Not the perfect place if you like long walks but good enough for a quick swim . And, surprisingly, there's a police point there right on the sand for extra safety!
title: nice but small

body: It could be a nice beach, but locals choose to park their buses on it as they do not need the space for sunbathing. There are many locals so bikini is not advised. Mirissa beach is more touristy, so you could sunbath there.
title: Local small beach

body: This is one of the must visiting place for tourists in Matara. Because of the big rock situated about 100metres away from the shore this place is just like a swimming pool. There are few beautiful corals also but you have to be aware of "Ikiri" some sort of sea animal that has needle like thorns. Before tsunami this was really a remarkable place but still you can enjoy this place. Anyway while bathing you have to follow the guiding as inexperience people can get drowned. There is no actual entry fee but you have to pay for parking. This is a safe place even for foreigners to enjoy. And there are near by good beach hotels too.
title: Natural Swimming Pool

body: Have visited the place on couple of occaisions. Can have an enjoyable sea bath. The sea is shallow and calm due to the shielding effect caused by the reef. The cool sea breeze sweeping across augments the feeling of relaxation. Hotels and guest houses are available around the vicinity providing food and lodging facilities. The beach is well patronized by the locals during holidays and hence tend to be somewhat crowded and noisy. Good place for a morning swim or a late evening dip prior to a relaxing dinner. However, swimmers need to be extra cautious not to venture out beyond the area demarkated with buoys as there could be strong currents at times caused by the flow of water from the 'Nilwala' river to the near by estuary.
title: Nice place for a sea bath

body: The beach is very famous for locals travelers.every week end it seems very rush but it is not negative point for visitors.Has many more shops and restaurant for bought any type of meals and other memorable things.More safety beach for every one.
title: Beach # Treat # Relaxation

body: its a nice beach, not so big, but nice. in the weekends its very popular with local people. sometimes its looking like a circus, watching locals doing tricks; human towers, acrobatic things, etc.
title: local beach

body: A beautiful beach to relax, foreign visitors please note that no sunbathing possible due large crowd . Dip in the sea is part of the fun . a popular hangout of locals
title: A beautiful beach to relax,no sunbathing

body: The beach is very nice and closed from big waves, but there aren't zone for tourists (sunbed, etc). One half of Matara citizens are here at Saturday and Sunday...
title: only for locals

body: The famous Polhena beach is one of the best sandy beaches is Sri Lanka. Which is very famous among locals though plenty of foreigners are attracted in the resent time. The beach is best to explore during the morning and you can walk to the coral reef which has got diverse marine life. The shallow water is so calm during the mornings and there won't be any waves. The see is very safe for children and make sure you stay on the safe zones to prevent currents which are there slightly away from the Polhena reef. Always ask locals before you jump in to deep water.
title: Magnificent beach and coral reef

body: Polhena Beach is not yet crowded compared to other beaches in the south. It is safe and clean place to have a sea bath. There are places for a fresh water bath and changing for a small price. Not too far from Matara town.
title: Have a relax sea bath in the evening.

body: A lovely beach, the main Polhena beach had a security station, taxi rank and small shop, but other bays further north (200m) were empty and idyllic - very safe swimming, good snorkeling for area.Definitely best in the area, saw plenty of surfers off the reef further north
title: Lovely beach, very safe - great snorkelling at either ends, inside the reef

body: I stayed there 3 days ,wonderful place ,very good for snorkelling,much better then some other beaches in srilanka
title: paradise

body: Im vachira Anjana its very good place to spend you time & to bathe no worries,people are very good.matara polhena beach very good.
title: verry Good Beach,

body: This is a really nice place for a sea bath. Lovely beach. But better avoid on long weekends and full moon days, as on weekends there is generally always a big crowd... And on full moon days the water is a little bit rough... On any other day the water is just perfect....
title: Good place for a sea bath...

body: Polhena beach is one of those beaches that is not yet very popular among the locals. So u can be sure that it wont be crowded. the beach is calm n the tides very low during the month of june. jst perfect for a swim. sometimes u can find men who sell fried fish, do not leave polhena without treating urself to one of those fishes. ask for extra lime. It tastes delicious.
title: Isolated but safe

body: The cleanliness is poor and it is crowded all the time. Some local residents are in the habit of poking into others busyness all the time and they are most of the time drunk. Not a place for taking kids. For a group of guys to hang out with a beer will be a better choice.
title: A beach but seen better...

body: Nice little strip with several eateries, not far from Matara. A good alternative to the more crowded and commercial places. Recommended if you like calm.
title: clean beach

body: We went there for some snorkeling. The corals are dead because of the tsunami in 2004 which is very very sad. But we were able to see and swim with a huge sea-turtle that came close to the beach to eat. Brilliant experience!
title: We saw a see-turtle!

body: On the weekdays the beach is virtually deserted, the water is clean and snorkelling before the reef is good.
title: Weekdays.

body: protected family beach much frequented by Sri Lankan and foreign tourists, but experienced swimmers longing for more than waist-deep waters may get bored there.
title: nice beach, suitable for children and non-swimmers

body: This beach is very famous among locals and even foreigners. you can see corral and many many tropical nice fish. But some time this beach seems not clean and not well maintained.
title: Nice beach in Down South Sri Lanka

body: The waters are safe to swim as the waves crash against the reefs turning this into something like a lagoon.On a good day you should be able to see quite a good number of colorful and fish and some turtles as well. The police now protects the turtle eggs which is appreciated by the locals as well. Be careful while snorkeling so that you step on or damage the corals in any form.The beach is a small stretch, avoid it on Public holidays as it can get very crowded.
title: Good snorkeling

body: Well as I grew up in Matara area, I have no idea about this whole "Nishantha" thing. As this is a public beach take your map out and go visit it. Its not hard to find the beach front and you just have to take the left turn from the Polhena Junction which directly goes to the beach. So this beach is exceptional compared to other beaches in the Southern Coast line. Polhena Beach is covered by a natural rock wall which has made the beach in to a natural pool. You can barely see waves within 200M and It's pretty safe to swim close to the beach (But do no go too far, as there are some underwater swirls time to time) . As I was schooling we had swimming contests in the beach by converting the beach in to a Pool by partitioning it with lines. The sand on the beach is not soft as in Matara beach but its not rough as in Colombo beaches. If you are planning to relax, swim and have fun in Southern coast line
title: Good Swimming pool like beach front

body: Woww.. i had an incredible stay in Matara !! I really liked the snorkeling!! He showed me everything and he stayed at my side :)I also did a jeepsafari and a boatsafari! Great! Nishantha is the perfect guide !! I couldn't wish someone better! Thank you so much! Sri Lanka .. It's a paradise! One day i will come back!
title: My stay in Sri Lanka
